title: Attacker can steal Staking reward
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  When `flashMint` is called, it sets `_shortCircuitRewards` to 1, preventing `_processPreSwapFeesAndSwap` from being executed. As a result, the collected fees will neither be swapped nor deposited into the staking pool's `POOL_REWARDS`.  ```solidity     function flashMint(address _recipient, uint256 _amount, bytes calldata _data) external override lock { >>>     _shortCircuitRewards = 1;         uint256 _fee = _amount / 1000;         _mint(_recipient, _amount);         IFlashLoanRecipient(_recipient).callback(_data);         /
